note: Reel 27: You're the Target. Episode 5 of 'You're the test subject'. The narrator is the series voice (af_heart). The officer (o01-o09) is placed from the cast reads (Kokoro is deterministic, so a cast read is take t1). Script 7: everything from the second knock rewritten (the user's pick 'C', then a fresh read). c01 is the whole hall in unison: the officer's voice with the other male voices layered under it. o13 and o14 are the next man's two lines, m03 a mother on the phone. place_vo.py reuses o09 and o02 for the repeats. cast_lines_earlier: what the earlier cast runs read. Facts and wording: docs/research.md. Read audio/vo_lab/takes/phonemes.md after every run.
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: Then find the three mistakes on this call.
Again. A parcel in your name.
Tell anyone, and they are arrested too.
You just looked at your door, didn't you?
Even though his badge can't spell police.
And even if it could, there's no such thing as a digital arrest.
You only know that because somebody told you.
While you hunted for mistakes, she took off her gold bangles, trying to prove she'd done nothing wrong.
You both looked at a door, and missed the last mistake.
Right now, they're dialling the next number.
lines.text_kokoro: Right now, they're dialing the next number.

lines.text: Hello? Hello? Can you see me?
Hello, hello? Can you see me?
